description: Add-Car Quote next-step prompts. Editable by business users via Rules Center.

ask_vehicle.zh: 先把年份和车型发我，我就能继续帮您报价。
ask_vehicle.en: Send me the year and make/model first so I can run the quote.

ask_zip.zh: 先把邮编发我，我就能继续帮您报价。
ask_zip.en: Send me the zip or address first and I will run the quote.

ask_delivery_driver.zh: 提车日期和主要驾驶人发我一下，我好安排报价。
ask_delivery_driver.en: Send me the delivery date and main driver so I can prepare the quote.

ask_driver_only.zh: 主要驾驶人发我一下，我好安排报价。
ask_driver_only.en: Send me the main driver so I can prepare the quote.
